scope: Host verifier for exact-source published native readiness
coverage: Fixed production-regression workflow and named readiness job
Full source SHA, repository and push event checked; successful PR-only checks insufficient
Latest matching run wins; older success cannot hide newer failure/pending run
Jobs read from exact run attempt, final run reread rejects concurrent rerun
Missing/duplicate/wrong-commit/skipped job and HTTP/malformed API failure reject
limitations: Native probe received HTTP404; no qualifying readiness was verified and this does not distinguish absent workflow from access restriction
Argo integration not applied; exact resolved commit must be guarded on both new-build and existing-image paths before any promotion
Does not replace exact-image smoke or release manifest/runtime checks
No Docker builds or external repository mutations
